  PROBLEM: The rb_stale_select_jq filter (`sort_by(.id) | last // empty`) picks the newest own-line `<!-- review-autofix-failure-cap:v1 ... -->` marker from any author and checks trust only afterwards, but the issue asks for the newest trusted marker, so an untrusted newer marker hides the older trusted one.
  WHY: All reviewers rated it MAJOR (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 filed it under security, the others under correctness); a newer marker from any commenter leaves `ai:review-blocked` stuck (`outcome=kept reason=untrusted_cap_author`, or `same_head_same_support`/`cap_not_pr_label`), which recreates the PR #9218 / #9229 state, and test_stale_clear_keeps_label_for_untrusted_cap_author (tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py) locks this behaviour in; it fails closed and grants no privilege.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:460 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `grep -qiE 'HTTP 404|Not Found'` matches any stderr that contains "not found" (for example "command not found", the shim error at scripts/gh_helpers.sh:119, or "Could not resolve to a Repository"), so a non-404 DELETE failure is classed as "already gone".
  WHY: All four reviewers rated it NIT; a failed DELETE logs `REVIEW_BLOCKED_STALE_CLEAR outcome=removed` with no `::warning::` while the label stays on the PR, so the required `outcome=error` signal is lost; the suggested fix is to match only `HTTP 404`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:441 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `rb_stale_login="$(gh api user --jq '.login // ""' 2>/dev/null)"` is not wrapped in `gh_retry`.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated it NIT; one transient 5xx/429 produces `marker_author_unavailable`, so the label is not removed until the next clean run.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:441,455-456 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The stale-clear path makes two new REST calls (`gh api user` and the label DELETE), but the issue allows only one extra REST call, the DELETE.
  WHY: Rated NIT; every stale-label cleanup uses one API request more than the budget allows, and the changelog records both calls (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that the extra call is recorded auto-decision AD-1).

  PROBLEM: `grep -qiE 'HTTP 404|Not Found'` treats any "not found" text as "already gone", including scripts/gh_helpers.sh:119 `gh: not found (AI_COMMENT_SIG shim)`.
  WHY: A DELETE that never reached the API logs `outcome=removed` with no warning while the label stays, so the required `outcome=error reason=delete_failed` is lost; fix: `grep -qE 'HTTP 404'`.

  WHY: A newer marker from any other login keeps the label with `outcome=kept reason=untrusted_cap_author`, the PR #9218 / #9229 state; it fails closed, so it is a correctness gap rather than a security one; test_stale_clear_keeps_label_for_untrusted_cap_author at tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py:720-722 locks in the shadowing.

  WHY: A failed DELETE logs `outcome=removed` with no `::warning::` and no `outcome=error`, which shows a false success; fix: tighten the pattern to `HTTP 404\b`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:around line 441 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
